'''November 2000 Namur tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Namur, Belgium on 26 November 2000. [[Julien Riviere]] won it. It is known from Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1498">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-27-namur-belgium-26-11-2000d1498/ namur-belgium-26-11-2000], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 27 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-27-namur-belgium-26-11-2000d1498/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 26 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Namur, Belgium
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Julien Riviere]]
